scope: CPU measurements and source diagnosis only. The existing Lean environment lookup is a baseline, not a new prover or model action.
scope_rule: The three additional imports are allowed only in a separate broader-import visibility control. No ordinary proof or original-scope cost comparison receives them. No author source proof or benchmark target declaration is imported.
trusted_preflight_reference: A hard negative requires an explicitly reviewed mandatory use of one exact fully qualified global declaration and absence in the exact imported Lean environment. A bare token, local binding, parser ambiguity, notation, branch fallback, or unreviewed proof never grants hard rejection. Unknown and non-mandatory cases still receive ordinary checking.
strong_controls: ordinary exact?/signature-directed proof and trusted full target verification
accounting: Measure material binding, process setup, probes, every accepted or rejected full proof, diagnostics barrier and shutdown separately. Do not compare a lookup-only number with a full checking number as an end-to-end speedup. Record coverage, false rejections, deferred cases and actual accepted target set.
method_gate: At least two independent real historical targets must show reproducible value over both direct full checks and existing context-aware Lean queries/retrieval under the same permission and candidate budget. Synthetic controls and an additional-import rescue cannot alone meet the gate. No model/GPU without gate.
